class.comment: Generate authenticated JSON management endpoints under the fixed /api/v1/security route for Users, Services, API Keys, OAuth Clients, Identity Providers, Tenant Resources, Roles, Role Memberships, Grants, Grant Catalog, security summary, and bootstrap maintenance. Require one documented action-specific management Scope for every operation. Provide create/read/list/update and reference-parity lifecycle, provisioning, activation, suspension, enablement, disablement, revocation, regeneration, Role membership, Grant assignment/removal, summary, and protected bootstrap-reset actions. Return exact 200, 201, and 204 success contracts and 400, 401, 403, 404, and 409 failures with field-addressed RFC 9457 Problem Details. List operations use deterministic ordering, pageNumber default 1 and minimum 1, pageSize default 25 and range 1-100, total count, and page metadata. Create, update, transition, regeneration, and provisioning accept optional 1-200 character idempotency keys retained with request fingerprints and original outcomes for 24 hours; update and state-transition operations require concurrency tokens and reject stale values without overwriting committed state. Every response projection excludes hashes, encrypted values, clear credentials, private keys, and protected correlation state.
class.name: SecurityAuthorityManagementEndpoints
